items.summary: The estimated 2,000-pound Steller sea lion nicknamed 'Chonkers' is hanging out at San Francisco's Pier 39 and drawing fans from across the country. The massive mammal made waves about a month ago when he hauled himself onto the pier and decided to stay. While California sea lions typically crowd the area, ‘Chonkers’ quickly stood out for his massive size. He is one of at least two Steller sea lions recently spotted in the bay. The animal is more commonly found in the colder waters of Alaska and the Pacific Northwest, making sightings in the Bay Area less common.
items.summary_zh: 估计2000磅的斯泰勒海狮被昵称"Chonkers",被挂出旧金山的39号码头并吸引出全国各地的粉丝. 巨型哺乳动物大约一个月前在码头上 制造出海浪,然后决定留下来 加州海狮通常挤满了当地, 他是湾里最近发现的至少两只斯泰勒海狮之一 该动物更常见于阿拉斯加和西北太平洋更冷的水域中,使湾区的目击活动更不常见.

items.title: Why is China banning drone sales in Beijing?
items.title_zh: 中国为何在北京禁止无人机销售?.
items.summary: China is to ban the sale of drones in Beijing and permits will be required to fly them under new rules that take effect on Friday.
items.summary_zh: 中国将禁止在北京销售无人机,并且根据星期五生效的新规则,飞行需要许可.

items.title: Joy as record-breaking runner Sawe returns home
items.title_zh: 欢乐作为破纪录的跑者 Sawe回家
items.summary: Sabastian Sawe, the first man to run a marathon in under two hours, has returned home to Kenya.
items.summary_zh: 萨巴斯蒂安语Name 第一个在两小时内跑马拉松的人Sawe已经回到肯尼亚。

items.title: 'Attacked 28 times in a day' - BBC visits heavily targeted US-UK base in Iraq
items.title_zh: “一天袭击了28次”——英国广播公司访问伊拉克时,
items.summary: The BBC has been given access to a military base in Iraq where UK forces have been working together with their US counterparts during the conflict in the region.
items.summary_zh: 英国广播公司获准进入伊拉克的一个军事基地,在该地区冲突期间,联合王国部队一直与美国部队合作。

items.title: The sub-Arctic town pitching itself as Canada's gateway to Europe
items.title_zh: 亚北极的小镇 把自己当作加拿大通往欧洲的门户
items.summary: The Port of Churchill sits idle for most of the year, blanketed by snow and frozen by the bitter cold climate of Canada's sub-Arctic. It's only operational in the summer for four months, sometimes five.
items.summary_zh: 丘吉尔港闲置了一年的大部分时间,被雪所覆盖,被加拿大亚北极的苦寒气候所冻结. 它只在夏季运行了4个月,有时是5个月.
